description: The pinned express@4.18.2 is affected by an open redirect vulnerability in malformed URLs, which can allow attackers to redirect users to attacker-controlled destinations.
evidence: express@4.18.2 is affected by GHSA-rv95-896h-c2vc / CVE-2024-29041 (Open Redirect); confirmed by osv-scanner and npm-audit.
remediation: Upgrade express to a fixed release such as 4.19.2 or later (4.22.2 recommended to also cover other express advisories).
title: Express.js Open Redirect in malformed URLs (CVE-2024-29041)

judge.reason: Aggregated from MoA candidates that passed false-positive judging.

description: The route handler builds an HTML response using template literal interpolation of variables (name, digest) without HTML-escaping, allowing reflected cross-site scripting when those values originate from untrusted input.
remediation: Escape untrusted values (e.g., via a vetted escape function) or render through a templating engine that auto-escapes by default; avoid interpolating raw input into HTML.
title: Unsanitized input interpolated into HTML response (reflected XSS)

description: The pinned express@4.18.2 is affected by a reflected XSS issue reachable through response.redirect() with user-controlled URLs, allowing attacker-controlled content to be rendered in the browser.
evidence: express@4.18.2 is affected by GHSA-qw6h-vgh9-j6wx / CVE-2024-43796 (XSS via response.redirect); confirmed by osv-scanner and npm-audit.
remediation: Upgrade express to a fixed release such as 4.20.0 or later (4.22.2 recommended).
title: Express.js XSS via response.redirect() (CVE-2024-43796)
